attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.effect: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself

attacks.name: Bind Wound
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

abilities.name: Energy Evolution
abilities.effect: When you attach a basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon that is the same type as that Energy card and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.

attacks.name: Code Check
attacks.effect: Look at 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards.

attacks.name: Confusion Wave
attacks.effect: Both Activate Pokémon are now Confused

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads this attack does 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Whimsy Tackle
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.effect: Flip a coin, If heas, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed

attacks.name: Searching Magnet
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Metal Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Signs of Evolution
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a Dratini, a Dragonair, and a Dragonite. reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
